Name: Joja Severance Settlement
Author: Ekibo3
Description:
[center][color=#a4c2f4][b][size=3]Did you really leave behind an entire corporate career… for 500g and a bus ticket?  [/size][size=3]Unacceptable: claim your severance and recover your remaining assets.[/size][/b][/color][/center]The letter includes:[list]
[*]Your [b]Joja National Bank account closure[/b]
[*]Liquidation of remaining funds
[*][b]Severance payout[/b]
[*][b]Mandatory relocation compensation[/b]
[/list]It doesn't assume loyalty, only past employment. This canonically applies to all players.

[b][size=5]📦[/size][color=#1e84cc][size=5]Features
[/size][/color][/b][size=3]✔ Lore-friendly Joja corporate letter
[/size]Full Joja National Bank protocol language, written in a formal and recognisably bureaucratic tone.

[size=3]✔ Configurable severance amount
[/size] Set your own payout via:[list]
[*][b]GMCM menu[/b], or
[*]Editing the config.json
[/list]
[size=3]✔ Farm Cave Event (Demetrius)
[/size]Because the severance payout counts as early income, Demetrius’ farm cave visit could trigger immediately on Day 1. An optional [b]Balanced / Delayed[/b] setting is included to move this event to a more natural point in early gameplay, without changing its dialogue or choices.

[size=3]✔ Letters from Parents[/size]
Vanilla parent letters normally trigger based on total money earned. This mod adjusts their timing, so they arrive based on [b]days played instead[/b], ensuring they feel natural and story-appropriate even with a large Day 1 payout.

[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/b]
[/list][b]
[size=5]⚙️[/size][color=#1e84cc][size=5]Installation
[/size][/color][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list][/b]
[color=#1e84cc][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color][list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b].
[*]Safe to add to existing saves. Recommended for fresh new playthroughs. 
[*]Does [b]not[/b] alter game balance beyond a one-time payout.
[*]Compatible with Joja route, CC route, expanded mods, & custom frameworks.
[/list][b][color=#1e84cc][size=5]Translations

Downloads.Description:
• Reworked vanilla money-based mail triggers to prevent early firing from the Joja severance payout.
• Added optional balanced pacing for Demetrius’ farm cave event.
• Updated parent and Tribune mail text for improved narrative consistency.
